Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.


Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

**About The Role:**


We are seeking a Senior Full\-Stack Software Engineer to join our high\-performance engineering organization as a full\-time, hands\-on individual contributor. In this role, you will be embedded within a cross\-functional team owning critical segments of our consumer ecosystem.


Our engineering organization is structured so that each domain team owns its vertical stack end\-to\-end—from backend microservices and APIs through frontend and DevOps. We are looking for an engineer with genuine depth across all layers of the stack who can move seamlessly between backend logic and rich frontend experiences, contributing independently within their first few weeks.


Beyond technical skills, we want someone who is innovative, proactive, and self\-driven—an engineer who actively seeks out better tools, raises quality standards, and delivers without waiting for direction. We place a premium on self\-learners who challenge the status quo, take genuine pride in the reliability of what they ship, and comfortably navigate ambiguity in a fast\-paced environment.


Potential Teams you will get to work on:


1\. New Constructions

* The Focus: Powering the leading builder listing platform in the US, empowering a diverse range of consumers to discover and customize their dream homes.
* What You’ll Work On: Building hyper\-customized web experiences for vibrant new communities, optimizing high\-velocity frontends for substantial traffic and search engine optimization (SEO), enhancing backend services, modernizing infrastructure, expanding automated test suites, and engineering automated developer toolchains for instantaneous cloud service provisioning.


2\. Mortgage \& Financial Services

* The Focus: Building the digital future of home financing by creating seamless, secure, and transparent financial tools for buyers and lenders.
* What You’ll Work On: High\-traffic loan origination flows, real\-time rate and affordability calculators, secure lead capture systems, compliance\-aware data architecture, and deep integrations with third\-party lender partner APIs.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Lead Electrical Engineer serves as a technical leader responsible for the design, development, validation, commercialization, and sustaining support of advanced electronic systems for downhole drilling and measurement technologies. This position leads electrical engineering efforts across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring product performance, reliability, manufacturability, and survivability in harsh high\-pressure/high\-temperature (HPHT) downhole environments.

The role provides technical leadership throughout the product lifecycle, from concept development and system architecture through qualification, commercialization, and field support. The successful candidate will collaborate with global engineering teams, customers, suppliers, and operational groups to develop innovative technologies that enhance company capabilities, improve reliability, and drive profitability.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITES:**

* Lead the design, development, validation, commercialization, and sustaining support of electrical and electronic systems for downhole drilling, measurement, and control technologies.
* Develop system architectures, design specifications, requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation throughout the product lifecycle.
* Own PCB and electronic hardware development from concept through production release, including schematic capture, component selection, layout review, testing, troubleshooting, and manufacturability considerations.
* Design and qualify electronic systems capable of reliable operation in harsh downhole environments including high\-pressure, high\-temperature (HPHT), shock, and vibration conditions.
* Lead technical decision\-making and provide engineering guidance throughout all phases of product development while collaborating with mechanical, manufacturing, quality, and operations teams.
* Develop and execute verification, qualification, environmental, and reliability test programs to ensure product performance, durability, and commercialization readiness.
* Lead root cause failure investigations, reliability improvement initiatives, corrective actions, and continuous improvement efforts to enhance product performance and field reliability.
* Manage multiple concurrent domestic and international engineering projects, ensuring technical, schedule, and budget objectives are achieved.
* Support field trials, product launches, customer demonstrations, and operational deployments while providing technical support to customers, sales, manufacturing, and field operations personnel.
* Identify, evaluate, and implement new technologies, products, and intellectual property opportunities that support strategic growth objectives and expand the company's technology portfolio.
* Collaborate with suppliers, contract manufacturers, and strategic partners to ensure component availability, product quality, manufacturability, and long\-term supportability.
* Serve as a technical liaison between global engineering teams, customers, and stakeholders while effectively communicating project status, technical risks, and development plans.
* Contribute to technology roadmaps, project planning, resource allocation, budget forecasting, and strategic business initiatives.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and development support to engineers and technicians while promoting a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with applicable company policies, engineering standards, quality systems, and regulatory requirements.

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS****:**

· Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or related discipline

· Minimum 7\-10 years of experience in electrical engineering, R\&D, or product development

· Experience designing and validating electrical systems

· Hands\-on experience with board\-level design and ruggedization, bring\-up, and debugging

· Valid driver’s license

· Valid passport and the ability to travel both domestically (frequently) and internationally (occasionally)

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS (PREFERRED)****:**

* Master’s degree in electrical engineering or related discipline
* Experience with
* embedded electronics and microcontroller\-based systems.
* high\-temperature electronic component selection and qualification.
* power management, battery systems, and low\-power electronics.
* EMC/EMI design and testing
* (PLM) systems and engineering change processes
* Familiarity with communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, CAN, RS\-485, Ethernet, and telemetry systems.
* Experience with design for manufacturability (DFM), design for assembly (DFA), and design for testability (DFT).

For MWD/LWD specifically:

* Experience with downhole telemetry systems including mud pulse, electromagnetic, wired drill pipe, or rotary steerable technologies.
* Understanding of drilling dynamics, shock, vibration, and downhole environmental effects on electronics.

Join us to lead transformative projects that shape the future of electrical engineering! We value innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence—if you’re ready to make an impact in a fast\-paced environment dedicated to engineering advancement, we want to hear from you!

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

  


### **ABOUT THE TEAM**


*The Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is on a mission to build next generation solid rocket motors for a safer, more connected world. To achieve our vision of becoming a large\-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers' capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.*  

  

**ABOUT THE JOB**  

  

As the Electrical Engineer, you will specify, design, develop and install devices used to collect data on solid rocket motor burn performance. Additionally, you will design custom electronic solutions—including PCBs, firmware, and FPGA code—needed to manufacture and test solid rocket motors, which will include working with integrated safety\-critical designs. This position also requires the ability to configure data collection systems and develop software applications used to collect the data. It is expected that you may oversee technicians during the instrumentation installation and during rocket motor testing/development. The right person for this role has direct, hands\-on experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors used to collect a variety of metrics related to testing of solid rocket motors. If you are a hands\-on leader, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and enjoy being the point person for collecting valuable performance data, then this role is for you. You will assist in the testing solid rocket motors which will include working with integrated safety designs used to initiate the motor.


#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Collaborates with other engineers to develop accurate, efficient equipment and instrumentation in accordance with safety and usability standards and client expectations.
* Collaborates with other electrical engineers to execute the safe arming and initiation of rocket motors under test.
* Designs PCBA and electrical system components with hands on testing and rework as necessary
* Creates detailed schematics and simulated models to test designs; optimizes designs for performance, reliability, and cost.

* Provides training related to devices to employees and/or customers.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Proven experience in safety\-critical hardware design, incorporating multi\-fault tolerance, arm/fire inhibits, safe bleed\-down circuits, and inadvertent initiation mitigation.
* Experience in high\-voltage PCB layout and circuit design for motor initiation, including capacitor charging/discharge circuits, high peak\-current switching, and creepage/clearance management
* Experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors employed to collect data on system performance.
* NI Labview or NI DAQmx experience or familiar with other COTS data acquisition systems
* Thorough understanding of signal conditioning for data acquisition, i.e. analog circuit design
* Intimate knowledge of the analog to digital conversion process, i.e. digital circuit design

* Able to select the correct sensors and design the placement of them to acquire the needed solid rocket motor performance metrics.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite and proficient with computer\-aided design software.
* Ability to write and understand Python

* Advanced degree in engineering

* Experience using EDA tools such as Altium/Or CAD

jobs.title: Robotics Systems Engineer II, Tech Deployment
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join Amazon's Robotics (AR) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy industrial robotics and automation technologies across North America's fulfillment network. In AR TD, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in A develop.
  

  

As a Systems Engineer in AR TD, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro\-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross\-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology \& Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third\-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on\-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon\-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go\-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel\-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.
  

  

\*\*Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Systems Engineer II, a candidate will typically own multiple simultaneous deployments of a single technology across multiple sites or oversee multi\-technology deployments within a single site; delivering within documented standards. This role requires a balance of experience both in working with high\-complexity industrial technologies, with complex, multi\-dependency project management. The ideal candidate is proactive and takes independent initiative in improving system performance and handling end\-to\-end deployment. In parallel to the execution, candidates will be responsible for driving continuous improvement ideas into both the deployment cycle time (safety, quality and productivity), and will be responsible for sharing engineering design improvements feedback to the hardware engineering and product teams, to simplify the installation. This role will require the ability to build relationships and capture and synthesize the voice of the customer.
  

You will manage the tactical deployment of large scale industrial automation technologies, ranging in technical complexity and product maturity from early alpha/beta to mature Generally Available.
  

  

* You will own the tactical execution (onsite coordination of installation and acceptance testing) to achieve the target “go\-live” date for each project assigned; delivering independently.
* You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams to convert technical requirements into refined deployment execution documents (schedules, Standard Operating Procedures, dependencies, etc.)
* You will improve operational metrics and team processes through automation and optimization
* You will independently resolve difficult technical problems during deployment, considering operational burden and making appropriate trade\-offs between time, quality, and resources
* You will create and improve standard work documents and operational guidebooks, and work towards automating or improving team processes.
* You will influence internal and partner teams towards meeting team level goals.
* You will develop subject matter expertise in one or more deployment domains
* You will mentor junior engineers and participate in technical assessment
* You will drive operational excellence initiatives with measurable results

  

A day in the life  

In this role you will be focused on execution of end\-to\-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, construction teams, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure a safe, on time, high quality product is delivered to the internal customer. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day\-to\-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve deployment execution first pass yield. You will work with senior engineers and your manager to develop technical depth and begin building strategic thinking skills for future growth.
  

  

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full\-time employees include:
  

  

1\. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
  

2\. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
  

3\. Paid Time Off (PTO)
  

4\. 401(k) Plan

Develop and execute an enterprise test automation strategy aligned with software development, quality engineering, and business objectives.

Establish automation success metrics, measure automation effectiveness and return on investment, and communicate results to management.
  
Define approaches for test\-data management, stable automation environments, continuous integration and continuous delivery, and integration with DevOps tools.
  
Partner with cross\-functional product, engineering, architecture, and business teams to prioritize automation, support in\-sprint testing, estimate delivery efforts, and drive process improvements throughout the software development lifecycle.
  
Work model

Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

Strong experience with Selenium\-based automation frameworks and at least one programming language such as Java, Python, JavaScript, or C\#.

Prior experience with Qualitia.

**About Fluidstack**
====================


We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built \- but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.  

  



We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them \- with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization\-scale infrastructure for AI.

  

  

**We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!**


**How We Operate**
==================


* **Be a barrel.** Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.
* **Insane urgency.** We drive everything forward as fast as possible.
* **Reason from first principles.** Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.
* **Love of the game.** The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.
* **Build something that actually matters.** If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

**The Capacity Delivery Team**
------------------------------


**Examples of key problems the team is working on**


* **Engineer gigawatts from drawing to energized, in months not years.** Capacity Delivery owns technical execution across every build: the drawings, the field questions, and the engineering calls that keep multiple concurrent gigawatt sites moving.
* **Engineer data centers that go up in months, not years.** At that pace rework is not an option: problems get caught on paper or they cost a data hall.
* **Design it once, build it a hundred times.** Every site's lessons roll into the reference design on the way to 10s to 100s of GWs, so each build starts ahead of the last.

**Role Scope**
--------------


* Own controls engineering for assigned sites: BMS and EPMS design review, integration oversight, and commissioning support.
* Review controls submittals against the standard: architecture, points, sequences, graphics.
* Oversee integrator programming quality before it reaches the field.
* Support Level 3 through 5 commissioning with engineering answers in hours.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


* The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would.
* You've engineered building or industrial controls on mission critical projects.
* You read and write sequences of operations.
* You've reviewed integrator work and sent it back with specifics.
* You debug controls issues from the points list up.
* Bonus: Niagara or Ignition. EPMS platforms. Networking for controls. Commissioning experience.

We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

jobs.title: Director of Systems Engineering, Integration & Testing (SEIT)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**

* **CAE Vision:** Our vision is to be the worldwide partner of choice in defense and security, and civil aviation by revolutionizing our customers’ training and critical operations with digitally immersive solutions to elevate safety, efficiency and readiness.
* **CAE Defense \& Security Mission:** CAE's Defense and Security business unit focuses on helping prepare military customers to develop and maintain the highest levels of mission readiness.
* **CAE Values:** Empowerment, Innovation, Excellence, Integrity and OneCAE make us who we are and we strive to make a difference in the world while helping each other succeed.
  

**What We Have to Offer:**

* Comprehensive and competitive benefits package and flexibility that promotes work\-life balance
* A work environment where all employees are valued, respected and safe
* Freedom to succeed by enabling team members to deliver, take initiatives and make decisions
* Recognition, professional development, advancement and having fun!
  

  

**Summary**

The Director of Systems Engineering, Integration \& Test (SEIT) is a senior technical and


organizational leader responsible for establishing, guiding, and assuring CAE’s integrated systems engineering, system architecture, verification, validation, and test execution activities across assigned programs. This role provides unified leadership over requirements development, change management, systems design, integration readiness, test program planning, and product acceptance assuring all engineering processes, artifacts, certifications, and test outcomes meet CAE, customer, and regulatory standards.

  

  

The SEIT Director leads a multidisciplinary team spanning systems engineers, architects,


integration engineers, test directors, instructional design, systems/software/hardware interface specialists, cyber engineering contributors, and verification/validation personnel. The Director


sets vision, defines processes, enforces engineering rigor, and drives execution excellence across the full lifecycle.

  

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Strategic \& Organizational Leadership**

* Establish and champion CAE’s SEIT strategy, operating model, workflows, and technical standards across programs.
* Lead the SEIT organization, overseeing staffing, skill development, resource forecasting, and team performance.
* Serve as the authority for engineering processes, systems engineering plans, integration plans, test approaches, and verification/validation frameworks.
* Ensure alignment and seamless coordination between product IPTs, Test IPT, Chief Engineers (CE), and Program Management as required.
* Develop, update, and enforce SEIT\-related policies, plans, and work instructions.
  

**Systems Engineering Leadership**

* Oversee requirements analysis, decomposition, allocation, management, and traceability throughout the full lifecycle.
* Ensure rigorous baseline control, configuration management, and proper change\-control processes.
* Guide system architecture development, interface definition, and system/subsystem design integration.
* Champion the technical review process, co\-lead major technical reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, TIMs, etc) with the IPT and CE teams, and ensure readiness artifacts meet required quality standards.
* Promote adoption of modern SE methodologies (MBSE, MOSA principles, DevSecOps\-aligned development, digital engineering).
* Ensure engineering products meet cost, technical performance, schedule, cybersecurity, availability, supportability, and quality metrics.
  

  

**Integration \& Test Leadership**

* Oversee development and execution of Integration and Test plans (STP), Acceptance Test Procedures (ATPs), readiness assessments, and integration milestones.
* Ensure early involvement of integration/test leadership during subsystem development phases to drive holistic readiness.
* Direct system\-level integration activities, including Hardware/Software Integration (HSI), Contractor Engineering Verification Test (CEVT), and customer acceptance events.
* Establish entry/exit criteria, deficiency tracking processes, and issue\-resolution methods in collaboration with QA, Test IPT, and customer organizations.
* Ensure test artifacts are complete, accurate, updated, and compliant with all configuration/data management requirements.
  

  

**Program Execution \& Governance**

* Support Bid \& Proposal efforts through requirements screening, WBS development, risk identification, BOEs, and SEIT scoping inputs.
* Participate in program start‑up, ensuring requirements validation, verification planning, and engineering readiness meet SEIT process and quality standards.
* Provide technical leadership and decision support across cross\-functional engineering teams and customer engagements.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, engineering efficiency, and standardized process execution across programs.
  

  

**Stakeholder \& Customer Engagemen** t


* Serve as a senior technical interface for system engineering and test matters as needed.
* Support customer technical reviews, acceptance events, audits, and on‑site integration/test activities as needed.
* Ensure clear communication of technical risks, issues, mitigations, and decision paths in close collaboration with the CE and program teams.
  

  

**Measurable Team Performance**

* Quality and completeness of SEIT artifacts and reviews
* Integration/test schedule adherence and acceptance success
* Requirements traceability accuracy
* Issues/deficiencies closure performance
* Team competency development and organizational health

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**HARDWARE TEST AUTOMATION ENGINEER, SATELLITES (STARLINK)**



At SpaceX we're leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world's most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world's largest satellite constellation with over 9,500 in\-orbit and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We've only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink's potential global impact and are looking for best\-in\-class engineers to help maximize Starlink's utility for communities and businesses around the globe.



As a Hardware Test Automation Engineer you will design, build, and automate test systems to support the development and qualification of satellite payloads, propulsion systems, mechanisms, and more. This role encompasses design, analysis, and manufacturing disciplines, with the ability to spearhead large\-scope projects from early design through implementation. * Develop, document, and implement cross\-functional automation solutions to improve test capability, coverage, and safety.

* Design user interfaces that make complex machines easy to use and troubleshoot.
* Create electrical, pneumatic, and fluid schematics.
* Provide innovative solutions to unique requirements and challenges faced by the team, which can range from specialized equipment to difficult installation locations.
* Perform electrical installation of valves, limit switches, potentiometers, transducers, etc.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline.
* 1\+ years of experience automating test systems.
* 1\+ years of experience with instrumentation, data acquisition (DAQ) system design, or electronics test engineering.


**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**


* 1\+ years of programming experience using Python, MATLAB, or C/C\+\+.
* Experience with one or more of the following electrical test equipment: oscilloscopes, digital multimeters (DMM), DAQs, power supply, electronic load, spectrum analyzer, source measurement unit.
* Experience with programmable logic controllers (PLC).
* Experience in one or more of the following: electronics test rack design and build, DAQ setup and field measurements, build of electronic systems or test systems for local assembly or industrial applications.
* Extensive knowledge of various digital and analog interfaces including but not limited to: USB, VISA, TCP/IP, CAN bus, SPI, I2C, Modbus, analog\-to\-digital conversion.
* Experience troubleshooting interactions between software and hardware.

* Able to collaborate with a wide range of people and effectively work in a team.
* Sound verbal and written communication skills.

* Willing to work weekends and extended hours as needed.

We strive to improve the quality of life of our employees by creating a work environment conducive to personal development, success and fulfillment. We are driven by our vision of being the preferred manufacturer, electrical systems integrator and worldwide service company by providing our clients with value\-added solutions that power their lives.

Electrical Engineering Manager

ABB is seeking a Senior Lead Electrical Engineer to serve as the technical authority for Protection \& Controls and Power System Studies within our Automation Energy Industries division in Houston, TX. * Investigate and analyze power system disturbances, equipment failures, and protective relay operations at customer facilities.
* Review engineering deliverables to ensure technical accuracy, consistency, and compliance with industry standards, project specifications, and internal engineering practices.

* Support the design and implementation of power management systems (PMS) *(scope varies based on experience).*

  



**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university and Professional Engineer (PE) license.
* 15\+ years of experience in power systems engineering, with significant depth in Protection \& Controls for medium and high voltage systems.
* Expert\-level knowledge of protection principles, relay coordination, protection scheme design, and proven ability to independently perform relay configuration and settings development (e.g., SEL, GE, Siemens, ABB, or similar platforms).
* Ability to lead and execute power system studies independently — from standard analyses (SC, LF, PC, AF) through advanced studies (dynamic stability, harmonics, transient analysis, grounding, motor starting, and voltage stability).

* Strong understanding of relevant industry standards and codes (IEEE, NFPA, NEC, ANSI, IEC, or equivalent).

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Data Solutions), AI & Data Platforms (AiDP)
jobs.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS\&T) organization. IS\&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2\.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS\&T makes the impossible feel effortless. Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.  

  

AI \& Data Platforms (AiDP) is IS\&T's engine for AI\-powered innovation. The team brings together data, application development, and machine learning \- including generative AI \- along with data services and customer success functions, to help IS\&T build solutions more efficiently and streamline the adoption and embedding of generative AI across Apple.  

  

**Description**  

  

We engineer high\-quality, scalable and resilient distributed systems on cloud that power data exploration, analytics, reporting and production models. Our core systems are diverse and come with an unusual intersection of high data volumes with systems distributed across cloud and on\-premise infrastructure.  

  

This role will build solutions that integrate open source software with Apple’s internal ecosystem. You will drive development of new components and features from concept to release: design, build, test, and ship at a regular cadence. You will work closely with internal customers to understand their requirements and workflows, and propose new features and ecosystem changes to streamline their experience of using the solutions on our platform.  

  

This is a challenging software engineering role, where a large part of an engineer's time is spent in writing code and designing/developing applications on cloud, with the remainder being spent on tuning and debugging codebase, supporting production applications and supporting our application end users. This role requires in\-depth knowledge of innovative technologies and cloud data platform with the ability to independently learn new technologies and contribute to the success of various initiatives.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

3 or more years of experience building enterprise\-level data applications on distributed systems  

  

Hands\-on experience in designing and development of cloud\-based applications that include compute services, database services, APIs to design RESTful services, ETL, queues and notification services.  

  

Experience in cloud data warehousing platforms like Snowflake is highly valued  

  

Experience developing Big Data applications using Java, Spark, Kafka is a huge plus  

  

Understanding of fundamentals of object\-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, and problem solving  

  

Cloud technology experience on platforms like AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud  

  

Data Visualization Tools: experience in software such as Streamlit, Superset, Tableau, Business Objects, and Looker  

  

Data Insights and KPIs: Working experience on generating and visualizing data insights, metrics, and KPIs. Usage of basic ML models in the space of anomaly detection, forecasting, GenAI.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

Knowledge of BI concepts and implementation experience on Cloud with databases like Snowflake or Big Query  

  

Programming experience in building high\-quality software with at\-least one of the following programming languages \- Python, Scala or Java.  

  

Experience in developing highly optimized SQLs, procedures \& semantic process for distributed data applications.  

  

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $225,300, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  

  

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

* Leads or independently executes systems engineering activities throughout the system lifecycle, including requirements development, architecture, design, integration, verification, validation, and test

* Coordinates engineering activities to ensure technical deliverables satisfy requirements and remain aligned with program objectives
* Provides systems engineering oversight of design, integration, verification, and test activities
* Advises Program Managers and engineering leadership on technical requirements, system impacts, risks, alternatives, and execution considerations
* Serves as a technical interface with customers, stakeholders, vendors, and subcontractors as appropriate
* Leads portions of technical reviews and support proposal and planning activities
* Provides technical guidance and mentoring to less\-experienced engineers
* Supports technical planning by providing inputs to program cost, schedule, staffing, and resource estimates

  

**Required Qualifications:*** Must be a US citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain US Government security clearance
* Bachelor’s in engineering or related science and 8\-15 years of relevant experience or a master’s and 6\-13 years of relevant experience
* Strong working knowledge of systems engineering processes across the system lifecycle
* Demonstrated experience with requirements development and verification, system architecture, interface management, risk management, configuration management, and trade studies
* Ability to evaluate technical alternatives and understand their impacts on system performance, cost, schedule, risk, and implementation
* Proficiency with systems engineering tools and analysis methods
* Ability to provide technical direction and influence engineering teams without requiring direct supervisory authority
* Experience supporting technical planning, cost estimating, and schedule development
* Strong organization and planning skills with the ability to manage multiple technical priorities
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain effective relationships with customers, stakeholders, and multidisciplinary teams
* Ability to travel as required

  

**Preferred Qualifications:*** Existing TS/SCI clearance
* Experience implementing Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) tools and processes
* Experience leading small\- to medium\-sized multidisciplinary engineering teams or technical efforts
* Experience with small satellite programs including risk mitigations, hardware development, and testing
* Understanding of the space environment

  

**Salary Range:*** $110,000\-$175,000

 **Why Join SDL?**  

  

SDL offers competitive salaries and **a comprehensive benefits package**. Visit our **Benefits Page** to learn more about what we offer.  

  

SDL delivers advanced multi\-domain solutions to protect national security and enable scientific discovery. Our expertise in satellites, sensors and instruments, ground systems and data processing, and autonomous systems plays a critical role in missions supporting NASA and the Department of Defense. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Strategic Defense
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**



The Strategic Defense team at Anduril is at the forefront of incubating and maturing AI\-native offerings for the integrated air and missile defense domain. We're the architects of mission autonomy and resilient mesh architectures, delivering scalable software solutions that meet some of the most urgent national security needs. By working hand\-in\-hand with elite teams in AI, Edge Hardware, Space Solutions, Networking, and Test Engineering we craft cutting\-edge, end\-to\-end systems that redefine mission success for major strategic capabilities.


**ABOUT THE JOB**  

  

As a Software Engineer, you will solve a wide variety of problems involving networking, autonomy, systems integration, robotics, and more, while making pragmatic engineering tradeoffs along the way. Your efforts will ensure that Anduril products seamlessly work together to achieve a variety of critical outcomes. Above all, Mission Software Engineers are driven by a "Whatever It Takes" mindset—executing in an *expedient*, *scalable*, and *pragmatic* way while keeping the mission top\-of\-mind and making sound engineering decisions to deliver successful outcomes correctly, on\-time, and with high quality.  

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Own the software solutions that are deployed to customers.
* Write code to improve products and scale the mission capability to more customers.
* Collaborate across multiple teams to plan, build, and test complex functionality.
* Create and analyze metrics that are leveraged for debugging and monitoring.
* Triage issues, root cause failures, and coordinate next\-steps.
* Partner with end\-users to turn needs into features while balancing user experience with engineering constraints.
* Travel up to 50% of the time to build, test, and deploy capabilities in the real world.


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Must be willing to travel up to 50% to Asia Pacific
* Fluent Mandarin language skills
* Strong engineering background from industry or school, ideally in areas/fields such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or Physics
* Experience working with a variety of programming languages such as Go, Rust, or Python
* Experience working with frontend frameworks such as React or Angular
* Experience building software solutions involving significant amounts of data processing and analysis
* Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex systems and established code bases
* A desire to work on critical software that has a real\-world impact


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* 4\+ years of professional industry experience working
* Developing software/hardware for safety critical functionality
* Distributed communication networks and message standards


The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including:

  


### **Benefits**



At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  



### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**



Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:


* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
	+ Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
	+ Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.co

HawkEye 360 is seeking a Sr. RF Electrical Engineer on the Space Team. The Space Team's mission is to design, build, and test small commercial satellites that provide revolutionary RF geospatial analytics.



You will perform RF and electrical design of our space platforms with a primary focus on our RF payloads. This includes RF front ends, integrating Software Defined Radios (SDR's) and antenna systems. This role requires strong RF and Electrical Engineering expertise working cross functionally with the mechanical, software, payload, and systems engineering teams.


**Your main responsibilities will be:**


* Design and develop RF payload architectures and Software Defined Radio systems for space\-based RF collection missions.
* Design and optimize RF front ends, including filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, and signal conditioning circuitry.
* Perform electrical and RF simulations at a board and system level to validate the performance of different sub\-systems.
* Perform RF link budget analysis, interference modeling, and sensitivity trade studies to meet mission performance requirements.
* Support payload architecture decisions through mission\-driven trade studies at PDR/CDR milestones.
* Define and scope RF performance test plans to verify key specifications including sensitivity, dynamic range, spurious emissions, linearity, and signal quality.

**Essential education and experience:**


* Bachelor's degree in RF/Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Expert understanding of software\-defined radio architectures, RF front\-ends, and space\-based RF systems.

jobs.title: Junior Combat Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Decision Technologies, Inc.**


Decision Technologies was founded to help bridge the gap between Department of Defense and Federal Government acquisition programs and technology to help our customers optimize their decision\-making process. Over the years, our areas of expertise have expanded to include Systems Engineering, Program Management, In\-Service Engineering, Equipment Repair, Research and Development, Test and Evaluation, and Intelligence and Counterintelligence Support. Our growth and success have positioned us as a premier engineering and intelligence services provider contributing to our nation's defense.


Our company culture cultivates talented problem\-solvers on focused on performance with industry\-leading teamwork and responsiveness. We have established a reputation for offering superior services and solutions, proven integrity and innovation, employee engagement and development, and customer collaboration.


Bring your expertise and knowledge to our team!

  

Bring the big picture together at the core of naval air and missile defense. As a Junior Combat Systems Engineer supporting the Navy’s Terminal Defense Systems program office, you will be the connective tissue between complex radars, guided missiles, automated launchers, and warship command\-and\-control architectures.

  

We are seeking a qualified **Junior Combat Systems Engineer** in **Arlington, VA**. This position is not eligible for hybrid or remote work situations. This is a 100% on\-site, in\-office position.

 **Position Description:**


Instead of focusing on just one isolated component, you will look across entire multi\-element combat weapon suites (such as Aegis and the Ship Self Defense System) to analyze requirements, map out digital architectures, define critical system interfaces, and verify performance through modeling, simulation, and live fleet testing. Working alongside senior systems architects and test directors, you will apply modern engineering methodologies to ensure diverse defensive technologies operate together seamlessly in high\-stress, real\-world operational environments.

 **YOU MUST BE ELIGIBLE FOR A DOD SECRET CLEARANCE**

 **Responsibilities and Duties:**

* + **Combat System Architecture \& Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE):** Build and maintain digital system\-of\-systems models using SysML and tools like Cameo/MagicDraw. Map operational requirements down to functional behaviors and software/hardware components, creating integrated digital architectures that demonstrate how terminal defense systems communicate across shipboard combat networks.
	+ **Interface Definition \& Data Flow Modeling:** Support the development, review, and integration of system\-to\-system interfaces and Interface Control Documents (ICDs). Define message protocols, track handoffs, latency bounds, and data structures linking weapons, search radars, and shipboard Command and Control (C2\) baselines.
	+ **System Requirements Analysis \& Traceability:** Analyze and decompose top\-level warfighter needs and threat baselines into clear, testable system and subsystem performance requirements using tools like DOORS. Track requirements traceability across the entire systems development lifecycle to evaluate readiness and identify functional gaps.
	+ **Fire Control Loop \& Engagement Integration:** Analyze end\-to\-end fire control loops from initial target detection, tracking, and combat system designation, to launcher positioning, missile fly\-out, and terminal intercept. Review firing policies, weapon scheduling rules, and battle management logic to eliminate response latency and maximize overall probability of kill ().

Description:  



**Position Overview:**


We are seeking a skilled and motivated Electrical Design Engineer II to join our engineering team in Roanoke, Virginia. This role is essential to support the Commercial, Manufacturing, and Field Service teams with electrical designs for fixed and mobile equipment used in the civil explosives industry. The initial focus of the position is low\-voltage DC circuit design, control panel layouts, and electrical CAD modeling and drafting on both new and legacy systems. As the role matures, scope will expand to include AC power distribution for fixed plant equipment and light PLC/HMI programming. The successful candidate will follow designs through the entire lifecycle \- working with the Commercial team on concept designs and specifications, Manufacturing on production and sustaining activities, and Field Service to provide comprehensive end\-user support. This position is ideal for an engineer with 2\-5 years of experience who is ready to take ownership of electrical systems on complex mobile and fixed equipment.

* Generate test plans to qualify and validate new electrical designs, including panel point\-to\-point checkout, continuity and insulation checks, and functional testing

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
* Excellent administrative, interpersonal, and communication skills
* Ability to work as an individual contributor with a team\-oriented mindset

**Preferred Skills:**

**Job Description:**

Are you a hands\-on engineer who loves bringing microcontrollers to life, tracing circuit boards, and making things fly? If you’ve spent your degree, capstones, or weekend projects tinkering with STM32s, ESP32s, or Arduinos—digging into logic analyzers and troubleshooting hardware\-software interfaces— **Airbus** has the ideal runway for your career.


We are seeking an enthusiastic **Entry\-Level Embedded Software Engineer** to join our Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) team. In this role, you won't just write abstract code behind a desk—you will be on the bench and in the lab, working directly on the hardware/software boundary of our next\-generation autonomous aircraft and ground equipment. From writing C/C\+\+ firmware and configuring low\-level communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN) to bench testing with oscilloscopes and supporting hardware bring\-up, your work will directly power physical, flying systems.  



  

**Meet the Team:**

The Airbus Helicopters Flexrotor Program offers one of the most advanced small tactical unmanned aerial systems (STUAS) with vertical take\-off and landing (VTOL). It can be used day or night by US and allied forces for a diverse range of intelligence, surveillance, target acquisition and reconnaissance (ISTAR) on land and at sea.  



  

**Your Working Environment:**

Nestled in the heart of the stunning Columbia River Gorge in Bingen, WA, our workplace offers innovation and the ability to contribute to game\-changing solutions while enjoying the flexibility to spread your wings. Whether it's solving complex challenges, or celebrating victories, you’ll be part of a cohesive crew that thrives on innovation and the beauty that the Pacific Northwest has to offer!  



  

**How We Care for You:**

* **Financial Rewards:** Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”)
* **Work/Life Balance:** Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program.
* **Health \& Welfare:** Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high\-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages.
* **Individual Development:** Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000\+ e\-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes and both national and international mobility.

**Your Challenges:**

  

**Primary Responsibilities: 100%**

* As an early career engineer, you will:
* Write, test, and debug embedded firmware (C/C\+\+) for microcontroller\-based systems used on aircraft and ground equipment.
* Assist in bringing up new hardware boards — bench testing, debugging with oscilloscopes/logic analyzers, and verifying sensor/peripheral integration.
* Support integration of embedded devices with communication interfaces (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, RF modules).
* Assist in troubleshooting field\-reported hardware/firmware issues, working with senior engineers to isolate root causes.
* Write and maintain technical documentation for firmware modules, hardware interfaces, and test procedures.
* Support unit and integration testing of embedded systems, including building simple test fixtures/scripts.
Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, and systems engineers during hardware/firmware co\-design.  
* 

  

**Additional Responsibilities:**

Other duties as assigned by the manager  

* 

  

  

**Qualified Experience and Training:**

**Education:**

Required


* Possess a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* Must have at least six (6\) months experience/internships/coursework programming microcontrollers (e.g., Arduino, STM32, ESP32, or similar) in C/C\+\+.
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and willingness to debug down to the hardware/firmware boundary.
* Demonstrated hands\-on project experience (school, club, or personal) building or programming physical devices.
* Proficiency in C/C\+\+ for embedded/microcontroller programming.
* Understanding of basic digital communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C).
* Ability to read and interpret basic circuit schematics.
Basic understanding of digital and analog electronics fundamentals.  
* 

  

**Preferred Skills:**

  

* Relevant coursework or project experience in embedded systems, digital logic, or robotics.
* Relevant Coursework: Digital and Analog Circuits, Operating Systems, Computer Architecture, etc.
* 1 year of experience (internships, co\-ops, capstone projects, or personal/club projects count).

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Test
jobs.description:
**Senior Software Engineer, Test**
==================================

**About Tin Can**
-----------------


Tin Can is building a safer, simpler way for kids to connect — without smartphones. We’re creating screen\-free, delightful devices and services that let families call the people who matter most, free from the noise of today’s digital world.


We’re building a bold, authentic, nostalgic, and kinda quirky brand that resonates with folks who want something simpler \& better for their kids than the tech\-infused lives we’re currently living (and who have a sense of humor about it). As we gear up to scale to thousands of families, we’re ready to bring on an engineer to help make it happen.

**The Role**
------------


When a kid picks up a Tin Can, the call has to work the first time, every time — whether that’s a call to Grandma or a call to 911\. That promise is only as good as our ability to prove it holds before a release goes out. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Test to own that proof: the automated testing that verifies every call path works, on every change, before it reaches a kid’s phone.


You’ll own our end\-to\-end and call\-path test suites and the checks that gate a release. The surfaces are real: a staging environment where a change can place an actual SIP call before it merges; a Flutter app on iOS and Android; firmware on ESP32 devices; and a call\-decision engine whose scenario suite you’ll grow into our strongest safety net. You’ll work alongside our voice, app, infrastructure and firmware engineers, and you’ll be the person who defines what “tested” means here.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own our end\-to\-end and call\-path test suites — the automated checks that tell engineers a change is safe to ship
* Build automated SIP test calls that run in staging before every merge — real calls verified for connection, audio, voicemail, and the call record afterward
* Guarantee emergency calling with continuous, safe verification, so we can show that every Tin Can reaches 911
* Grow regression coverage across the paths families depend on most — voicemail, contact approval, missed calls — so every release protects them
* Automate the manual parts of our release process across mobile, backend, and firmware, so releases get faster and safer as the fleet grows
* Shape our CI/CD: what runs on every pull request, what gates a deploy, and what a failing check blocks
* Partner with firmware on repeatable release testing, and push on testability — device emulation, test hooks — so device behavior is verified automatically on every build
* Measure the suites themselves — coverage of the paths families use, signal engineers can trust, and defects caught before they ship

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5\+ years in software engineering, with deep experience in test automation for production systems where a failure is something a customer feels immediately
* You’ve built end\-to\-end suites engineers actually trust — fast, deterministic, wired into CI, and rare enough to be believed when they go red
* Comfortable in the guts of a distributed system; you can follow a request across services, read the telemetry, and write a test that proves behavior rather than restating the code
* Fluency using AI as a multiplier across diagnosis, analysis, and testing; this is how we work, not a nice\-to\-have
* A clear communicator who writes things down, because a test suite nobody understands is a test suite nobody maintains
* Hands\-on and scrappy; you’ll build the harness, the fixtures, and the CI plumbing yourself, and you’d rather automate a test than run it twice
* A collaborative, low\-ego approach — everyone here sweeps the floor
* Bonus: VoIP or telephony testing (SIP/RTP, sipp, synthetic call monitoring); mobile release testing across iOS and Android; or hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing for embedded devices

**Why Join Tin Can**
--------------------

* **We’re building tech that protects childhood:** We’re on a quest to give kids a more analog childhood — one with real conversations, real connection, and way less screen time. No doomscrolling, data mining, or dopamine traps — just a simpler, better way for kids to stay in touch. This is a rare opportunity to build something that truly matters.
* **You’ll guarantee the call that matters most:** Every Tin Can can dial 911, and you’ll build the verification that proves it — then hold the same bar for every other call a family counts on, across the device, the app, and the call path.
* **Small, high\-trust team:** Every company says “team,” but at Tin Can it means something different. We’re a small, mission\-driven group that genuinely has each other’s backs — professionally and personally. You’ll be joining a tight\-knit crew where your ideas and instincts matter from day one.
* **Room to explore, not just execute:** You’ll have the space to explore new ideas, challenge assumptions, and build systems that reflect our values of trust, simplicity, and care.


If you’re excited by the idea of making every Tin Can release something families never have to think about — and building the tests and tooling that get us there — we’d love to meet you.


Compensation Range: $175K \- $195K

**About WSDOT**


The Washington State Department of Transportation (WSDOT) is a multimodal agency with a global reputation for excellence. Our dedicated workforce plans, designs, builds, and operates an integrated transportation system that safely and efficiently moves people and goods throughout the state. In addition to maintaining over 20,000 lane miles of state highway and 4,100 bridges, WSDOT leads an award\-winning Active Transportation Plan, manages the world's longest floating bridge, and operates the largest ferry system in the nation!


Washington State Ferries (WSF) is an essential part of Washington's transportation network. Every year, we carry nearly 20 million passengers across Puget Sound and the San Juan Islands on more than 400 sailings a day. Our dedicated teams with over 2,100 people work together to serve our communities and shape the future of ferry travel.

jobs.description:
At Infoblox, every breakthrough begins with a bold **“what if.”**  

**What if** your ideas could ignite global innovation?
  

**What if** your curiosity could redefine the future?


We invite you to step into the next exciting chapter of **your** career journey. Bring your creativity, drive, your daring spirit, and feel what it’s like to thrive on a team big enough to make an impact, yet small enough to make a difference. Our *cloud* \-first networking and security solutions already protect **70% of the Fortune 500** , and we’re looking for creative thinkers ready to push that influence even further. Join us and discover how far your bold “what if” can take the world, your community, and your career.


Here, how we empower our people is extraordinary: **Glassdoor Best Places to Work 2025, Great Place to Work\-Certified in five countries, and Cigna Healthy Workforce honors three years running** — and what we build is world\-class: recognized as **CybersecAsia’s Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024** — evidence that when first\-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So, **what if** the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next”.


In a world where you can be anything, **Be Infoblox** .


**Senior Software Engineer**

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Universal Asset Insights team, located in Tacoma, WA, reporting to the Senior Director of Engineering. In this role, you will work on Infoblox Universal Asset Insights, which automates the discovery and analysis of both IP\-based and non\-IP\-based assets across public clouds, on\-premises networks, IoT/OT devices, and third\-party applications. Integrated with Infoblox's critical network services, including DNS, DHCP, and IPAM, it enhances network visibility and IPAM accuracy. You will work closely with Product management \& engineering leadership to execute product roadmap \& also engineering goals of building scalable, reliable \& maintainable software. You are the ideal candidate if you are a great collaborator, strategic thinker, operate independently, and are deadline and results\-driven.


**What you’ll do:**

* Design and develop cloud hosted Data ingestion, transformation, normalization pipeline built to scale, perform and reliable
* Design and build extensible framework that enables low\-code/no\-code integrations, allowing customers and partners to build new asset sources
* Lead cross functional \& global engineering teams to collaborate on building re\-usable software components that can be delivered as a platform
* Drive productivity \& innovation through adoption of Agentic/AI Platforms in SDLC including Design, Development, QA, Automation, Deployment, Observability, Maintenance \& troubleshooting
* Drive Product innovation through adoption of Agentic infrastructure into Product core capabilities including building \& productizing MCP Servers, Building Agents, sub\-agents, skills etc.
* Provide technical leadership to steer product architecture and software design, ensuring the delivery of a scalable, extensible, and reliable system
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product Management and Marketing on roadmap, documentation, and other collateral
* Stay up to date on key trends in asset insights, no\-code/low\-code approaches for remediation, data transformation, ETL, agentic AI, etc.

**What you’ll bring:**

* 8\+ years of experience in software development using Golang/Go, Java, C\+\+, or C, leveraging microservices\-based Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka
* 8\+ years of experience building large scale SaaS\-based Network Management, ETL, asset management, data pipelines with ingestion, transformation \& persistence, projection, API \& presentation layers
* Excellent working knowledge of Data Modeling, APIs, System Architecture \& design
* Excellent understanding of relational, time\-series, NoSQL, Graph databases
* Strong hands\-on expertise applying agentic and AI‑driven frameworks to elevate engineering productivity, optimize performance, and strengthen system reliability including building Agents, Sub\-agents, MCP Servers, Skills etc.
* Strong hands\-on experience with performance engineering in large scale pipelines and active participation in resolving production incidents
* Good understanding of networking like switching, Routing, Security and preferably DNS, DHCP, IPAM, CTEM, CAASM, ITSM
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams across different time zones
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or electrical engineering required; master’s degree preferred

**Be Successful — Your Path**

**First 90 Days:** Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short/long term goals.


**Six Months:** Get a very good understanding of Infoblox Asset Insights Product offering


Design and develop some features, contribute to code and design Reviews and identify productivity and extensibility enhancements for integrations/adapters.


**One Year** : Develop major features toward extensibility to rapidly onboard integrations, make significant contributions toward architecture and design improvements, make significant improvements toward productivity, quality, and reliability and collaborate closely with Product Management and identify areas for R\&D.


**Belong—** **Your Community**

Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.


**Be Rewarded —** **Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong**

* Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options
* Learning opportunities

jobs.title: Robotics Systems Engineer II, Tech Deployment
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join Amazon's Robotics (AR) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy industrial robotics and automation technologies across North America's fulfillment network. In AR TD, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in A develop.
  

  

As a Systems Engineer in AR TD, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro\-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross\-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology \& Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third\-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on\-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon\-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go\-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel\-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.
  

  

\*\*Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Systems Engineer II, a candidate will typically own multiple simultaneous deployments of a single technology across multiple sites or oversee multi\-technology deployments within a single site; delivering within documented standards. This role requires a balance of experience both in working with high\-complexity industrial technologies, with complex, multi\-dependency project management. The ideal candidate is proactive and takes independent initiative in improving system performance and handling end\-to\-end deployment. In parallel to the execution, candidates will be responsible for driving continuous improvement ideas into both the deployment cycle time (safety, quality and productivity), and will be responsible for sharing engineering design improvements feedback to the hardware engineering and product teams, to simplify the installation. This role will require the ability to build relationships and capture and synthesize the voice of the customer.
  

You will manage the tactical deployment of large scale industrial automation technologies, ranging in technical complexity and product maturity from early alpha/beta to mature Generally Available.
  

  

* You will own the tactical execution (onsite coordination of installation and acceptance testing) to achieve the target “go\-live” date for each project assigned; delivering independently.
* You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams to convert technical requirements into refined deployment execution documents (schedules, Standard Operating Procedures, dependencies, etc.)
* You will improve operational metrics and team processes through automation and optimization
* You will independently resolve difficult technical problems during deployment, considering operational burden and making appropriate trade\-offs between time, quality, and resources
* You will create and improve standard work documents and operational guidebooks, and work towards automating or improving team processes.
* You will influence internal and partner teams towards meeting team level goals.
* You will develop subject matter expertise in one or more deployment domains
* You will mentor junior engineers and participate in technical assessment
* You will drive operational excellence initiatives with measurable results

  

A day in the life  

In this role you will be focused on execution of end\-to\-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, construction teams, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure a safe, on time, high quality product is delivered to the internal customer. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day\-to\-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve deployment execution first pass yield. You will work with senior engineers and your manager to develop technical depth and begin building strategic thinking skills for future growth.
  

  

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full\-time employees include:
  

  

1\. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
  

2\. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
  

3\. Paid Time Off (PTO)
  

4\. 401(k) Plan
